The report states that the Claude website and Claude Code were not working for many users while other components were listed as operational. For the occurrence recorded as ‘Claude website and Claude Code suffered a major outage on 7 April 2026’, the service-access and operational harm was meaningful but bounded in scope or shown consequence, without evidence of grave or lasting harm. The evidence does not establish complete duration or reversibility beyond the consequence described. Threshold applied: Critical or important function unavailable for more than 2 hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over 5% or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over 1 hour; recovery remains bounded.
